categories.name: صِفَاتُ الْوُجُوهِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
categories.nameEn: Descriptions of Faces in the Hereafter

items.verse: وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
items.verseEn: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

categories.name: صِفَاتُ الْمُكَذِّبِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِ فِي سُورَةِ الْقَلَمِ
categories.nameEn: Attributes of the Arrogant Denier in Surah Al-Qalam

items.verseEn: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
[And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.

categories.name: أَدْوَارُ النَّبِيِّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Roles of the Prophet Muhammad in the Quran

items.verseEn: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.
You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.

items.verse: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۖ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
items.verseEn: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

items.verse: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
items.verseEn: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

categories.name: أَلْفَاظُ الْعَذَابِ وَالْوَعِيدِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Terms of Divine Punishment and Warning in the Quran

items.verse: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
items.verseEn: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,

items.verse: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
items.verseEn: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].

items.verse: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
items.verseEn: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
items.verseEn: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
